_note: PE-15: commander-guard.ps1 is saved WITHOUT a BOM while its message body contains '§' (gate-protocol.md § 1), so PowerShell 5.1 parses the FILE ITSELF in the system codepage and the master's own printed message is mangled -- a live master-source defect, not a port bug. Exit code still matches (both block); this fixture is also the boundary case proving a genuinely non-exempt deliverable path (src/App.tsx, no separator ambiguity, not under any exempt fragment) is still BLOCKED -- required alongside every PE-17 citation in this file so the exempt list does not read as having quietly gone universal.

PE-17 (owner-approved, deliberate loosening): commander-guard.ps1's $EXEMPT_PATTERNS are backslash-only regexes ('\\docs\\plans\\'); this fixture's file path carries a forward-slash tail after the sandboxed cwd, so the master's pattern fails to match and it BLOCKS a path that was always meant to be exempt. The port normalises separators (lib.paths.to_posix) before matching, so it correctly exempts. The SET of intended-exempt paths is unchanged, only the spellings that reach it -- required for the port to work on POSIX at all, since a backslash-only pattern matches nothing there.

PE-17: same separator-brittleness as commander-06, applied to '\\Temp\\claude\\' and '\\scratchpad\\' -- ${TEMP} resolves to a Windows path and this fixture appends a forward-slash tail, so the master's backslash-only patterns miss it and BLOCK; the port's separator-normalised match correctly exempts.

PE-17: ${ELSEWHERE} is a sandboxed sibling path with a mixed-separator tail; the same outside-cwd/exempt determination is separator-sensitive on the master and separator-normalised on the port -- master BLOCKS, port correctly ALLOWs.
PE-17: same separator-brittleness, this time against the .claude exempt fragment -- backslash-only on the master, separator-normalised on the port.
old: file.StartsWith(cwd) treats C:\repo-backup\x as inside C:\repo and blocks under enforce; new: paths.is_under() is component-wise and exempts it.

F-16 (blank file_path still blocks, preserved not fixed) PLUS PE-15: commander-guard.ps1's BOM-less file containing '§' is mis-parsed by PowerShell 5.1's system-codepage read, mangling the master's own message text. NotebookEdit sends notebook_path, not file_path, so file_path is blank; the blank path matches no exempt pattern and skips the outside-cwd exemption too (it only applies to a non-blank file), so this blocks under enforce on both sides -- exit code matches, only the master's own text is garbled.
